This is a one time only Offer where you can choose your favorite DC Character to instantly add to your roster! Tap the + inside the frame to go to the Character Selector, tap the Character icon to make your selection, and then tap Confirm to finalize your choice. If you want to change the selected Character, tap the Refresh button on the top right of their portrait. If you choose a Character you already have, you will instead receive Fragments for that Character that can be used to Rank them up as follows: 60 Legendary Character Fragments or 40 Epic Character Fragments
